description: This file implements a Mocastub class for handling parameter get/set operations, module initialization, prerequisites setup, and cleanup in a test framework. It interfaces with external C functions to communicate with underlying system components and uses JSON for request/response handling.

classes.name: Mocastub
classes.description: A class providing methods for parameter management and module lifecycle operations within a test framework; includes initialization, prerequisites, get/set operations, and cleanup.

methods.name: bool initialize(IN const char * szVersion)
methods.description: Initializes the Mocastub module, registering it with the test framework.

methods.name: std::string testmodulepre_requisites()
methods.description: Sets up prerequisites for the test module by registering with the underlying system.

methods.name: bool testmodulepost_requisites()
methods.description: Cleans up prerequisites for the test module by terminating registration with the underlying system.

methods.name: void Mocastub_Get(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Handles parameter retrieval via external API and formats the response in JSON.

methods.name: void Mocastub_Set(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Sets a parameter value via external API and validates the set operation.

methods.name: void Mocastub_SetKeypassphrase(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Sets a key/passphrase parameter and confirms success.

methods.name: void Mocastub_SetOnly(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Performs a set operation and reports success or failure.

methods.name: Mocastub * CreateObject(TcpSocketServer & ptrtcpServer)
methods.description: Factory function to create a new Mocastub object.

methods.name: bool cleanup(IN const char * szVersion)
methods.description: Shuts down the Mocastub module, performing cleanup operations.

methods.name: void DestroyObject(Mocastub * stubobj)
methods.description: Deletes a Mocastub object when no longer needed.

ctags.pattern: /^void Mocastub::Mocastub_Get(IN const Json::Value& req, OUT Json::Value& response)$/

ctags.pattern: /^void Mocastub::Mocastub_Set(IN const Json::Value& req, OUT Json::Value& response)$/

ctags.pattern: /^void Mocastub::Mocastub_SetKeypassphrase(IN const Json::Value& req, OUT Json::Value& response)$/
